part.text:
Implemented the `tokio::fs::File::poll_read` empty-buffer fast path in `tokio/src/fs/file.rs`.

`poll_read` now returns `Poll::Ready(Ok(()))` immediately when `dst.remaining() == 0`, before tracing or scheduling a blocking zero-byte read. This prevents an empty read from leaving a completed zero-byte operation that makes the subsequent nonempty read appear to be EOF.

Validated with:

```sh
/usr/local/cargo/bin/cargo test -p tokio --features full --test fs_file empty_read
/usr/local/cargo/bin/cargo test -p tokio --features full --test fs_file
```
